method: Country-authored derived estimates combining official OFC/FIFA structural evidence with Big Count 2006 and Professional 2023 where present.
evidence_rules: Earth catalog uses SLB for Solomon Islands even where football abbreviations differ.
Missing FIFA Professional 2023 values for PNG, SLB and COK remain unknown and never become zero.
Per-capita participation primarily informs popularity/access, not competition or elite-support depth.
Archipelagic/geographic constraints affect access/development context and do not alter innate player potential.
Current FIFA Forward or association-network evidence is not backcast into earlier decades.
Pre-association years for sparse countries remain explicit low-confidence backcasts rather than fabricated historical precision.

country_notes.FJI: Long pre-1955 organised structure, strong modern participation density, small explicit professional ecosystem and current infrastructure investment.
country_notes.PNG: Large absolute participation but much lower per-capita density and material geographic barriers; modern competition/support remains low-confidence.
country_notes.SLB: Football is culturally dominant and participation is dense, while absolute competition/elite-support depth remains bounded by scale and sparse professional evidence.
country_notes.COK: Exceptional per-capita registration/club density supports high access while tiny population and absent professional data keep competition/support modest.
